svg.title: Goals and constraints
svg.desc: How does a person specify what the system should do? Distinguish conveying intent, providing a structured or executable specification, and declaring constraints or evaluation criteria. Source illustration: Situated keep/remove judgments supply examples of the content a person wants the classifier to retain.

text.tspan: How does a person specify what the system should
Lets people state what they want through goals, rules, criteria,
examples or structured inputs that the system can act on.

a.aria-label: FC057: structured input form or schema
FC058: authoring a formal or executable representation
FC055: explicit constraint or rule specification

text.tspan: Recorded form · FC055: Rule, criterion or rubric authoring (VA042).
